title: •_Tantive IV_
caption: •_Tantive IV_ (V)
game_text: May deploy without presence or Force icons. May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Adds one {light-force} and one {dark-force} at same Dark Side system. [Ship-docking]
lore: Royal House of Alderaan consular ship. Used by Princess Leia for Imperial Senate business (and secret Rebel espionage). Captured by the _Devastator_ over Tatooine.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. 'Tantive IV' italic in the slip's heading and caption and on the printed title (marked _…_). Banner CAPITAL: CORELLIAN CORVETTE. Stats POWER 5 / ARMOR 4 / HYPERSPEED 3; deploy 4 / forfeit 7 (printed card 5 / 8). Scomp-link ring at the top-left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: yellow Pilot helmet (permanent pilot, as vs6/05 Bright Hope) and red square with green dome → nav. Inline icons: blue/white streak square = {light-force}, black/pink streak square = {dark-force} (stub reads [Light Side] / [Dark Side]). '[Ship-docking]' is printed literally in square brackets on the slip. Lore corrected from scan: '_Devastator_' is italic (wiki plain). The only scan, ANH-L-tantiveiv.gif (745 px), is tagged D-E1 (PC rescan) but its top half and printed game text match the Decipher card; used as art src with that caveat. Copyright 1996 legible. Modern: V1-L-tantiveiv.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 1 remake); VB1 (350) also exists, not downloaded.
